brand.name: PEL
brand.notes: Pak Elektron Limited (PEL), Lahore — founded 1956, Saigol Group. Appliance lines: InverterOn, Full DC, T3; also distributes LG (since 2009) and Panasonic (since 2020) in Pakistan. No public PEL AC service manual with an error table found as of 2026-09-23; data from two agreeing PK technician sources (Electra Fix, Holife) plus field videos for P1. Packaged AC user manual exists (manuals.plus) but was not scraped for codes. See docs/sources/pel.md.
